content:
“At least you're an efficient bloodsucker!”

**Bloodsucker** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Bloodpacks and Cannibal now satisfy thirst, no longer irradiate, and heal twice as much.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Bloodpacks and Cannibal now satisfy thirst, no longer irradiate, and heal twice as much. | 00382A57 | 

Bloodsucker affects the following chems:

- Bloodsucker can be stacked with Chem Fiend to increase the healing yield, as all blood packs are treated as chems.
- Bloodsucker can be stacked with Healing Factor to increase the healing yield, although the full benefit will not be received, as all blood packs are treated as chems.

- Glowing blood and High-radiation fluids are not affected by the Bloodsucker perk. [verified] 

|}
